name: 看板
description: 你这台电脑上的一块任务看板：卡片挂上本机任务，任务在跑、在等你批准，卡上直接看得到；任务里的文件和群文件在卡片里就地看、就地改。agent 也能用工具领卡、推进。

en.name: Board
en.description: A task board on this computer: link cards to your tasks and see on the card whether each is running or waiting for your approval; read and edit tasks' files and chat files right in the card. Agents take and move cards with its tools.
